method: Proper conjugate Bayesian anatomy + anisotropic spatial-basis regression; section nuisance effects
fit_scope: all reference cells; section-adjusted fitted spatial summaries, not held-out predictions
credible_target: 95% posterior credible interval for section-adjusted latent mean
predictive_target: 95% new-cell interval including new-section offset and observation noise

cross_validation.scheme: 5 contiguous whole-section blocks with 1 neighbor section guarded per side

limitations: Gaussian fitted means, latent intervals and predictive distributions can be negative on the physically nonnegative ln(1 + count) scale. Predictive negative mass is quantified; fitted quantities and intervals are never clipped or presented as raw-count predictions.
Latent-mean credible intervals are not new-cell predictive intervals; empirical coverage is assessed only for the latter.
Full-reference posterior arrays are in-sample fitted spatial summaries; held-out metrics come exclusively from refits excluding test/guard sections.
No PM response, differential expression, protein abundance, additional resolution, missing-gene expression, new positions, cell generation, mirroring or relocation is inferred.
